newsitem.title: CHINA: China Resources joins Cosmos Mach board.
newsitem.headline: China Resources joins Cosmos Mach board.

text.p: Directors of China Resources (Holdings) Ltd (CRC) have joined the board of Cosmos Machinery Enterprise Ltd with the completion of the company's acquisition of Welltech Industrial Equipment Ltd, Cosmos said on Wednesday.
Cosmos Machinery announced the acquisition of Welltec from China Resources Holdings in April 1997 in exchange for a 24.3 percent stake in Cosmos.
CRC executives Huang Zhijian and Wang Junqing have been nominated by CRC to the Cosmos board, a company statement said.
Huang holds a master and Ph.D degrees in mechanical engineering from the University of Manchester in the UK. He joined CRC in 1986.

Wang holds a degree in machine engineering and has more than 30 years' experience in the trading business. Wang, who joined the China Resources group in 1983, is chairman and general manager of China Resources Machinery Company Ltd (CRM), the statement said.
CRC is the parent company of China Resources Enterprises Ltd.
